description: This file contains functions and types for resolving and managing Matrix configuration settings, including environment variable handling, secret references, and account-specific configuration resolution.

methods.name: readEnvSecretRefFallback
methods.description: Reads a secret reference from environment variables with fallback handling.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans secret input values, handling secret references and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveMatrixBaseConfigFieldPath
methods.description: Generates the configuration path string for a given Matrix config field.

methods.name: shouldAllowEnvSecretRefFallback
methods.description: Determines if environment secret ref fallback is allowed for a specific field.

methods.name: hasConfiguredSecretInputValue
methods.description: Checks if a secret input value is configured (non-empty string or secret reference).

methods.name: hasConfiguredMatrixAccessTokenSource
methods.description: Checks if the Matrix access token source is configured via secrets or environment variables.

methods.name: readMatrixBaseConfigField
methods.description: Reads and cleans a specific field from the base Matrix configuration.

methods.name: readMatrixAccountConfigField
methods.description: Reads and cleans a specific field from a Matrix account configuration.

methods.name: clampMatrixInitialSyncLimit
methods.description: Ensures the initial sync limit is a non-negative integer.

methods.name: buildMatrixNetworkFields
methods.description: Builds network-related configuration fields such as private network allowance and SSRF policy.

methods.name: resolveGlobalMatrixEnvConfig
methods.description: Resolves global Matrix environment variables into a configuration object.

methods.name: resolveScopedMatrixEnvConfig
methods.description: Resolves scoped environment variables for a specific Matrix account.

methods.name: resolveMatrixConfigForAccount
methods.description: Main function to resolve the complete Matrix configuration for a specific account, considering environment variables, secrets, and account settings.
